description:
When criminal Cyberanarchists appear in the Cyberland, the vast 21st century computer networks, Alice, Miss Catnick, Leina, and Julie are drawn in by the mysterious Lucia to become a fighting force of young girl soldiers in the Cyberland to combat the criminal element.

Note: A second episode originally broadcast on TV TOKYO alongside the first episode, but never released on home video despite an announced release date due to low sales of the multimedia franchise and the bankruptcy of the production company. This also halted the continuation of the multimedia franchise, although a sequel game scenario script exists on Chiaki Konaka's website.
